name: Terrance
description: Veryl's younger brother, who attacks Mia with a sword.

timeline.summary: Mia fights off hooded attackers, including Kyle and Terrance, shooting one assailant in the stomach.
timeline.quote: The grip loosened and she turned around and fired blindly into the stomach of her assailant.

timeline.summary: Wilbur knocks out Terrance, apologizes that things got out of hand, and says he has only ever seen bubbles.
timeline.quote: I'm so sorry. Everything got out of hand.
